function_revised: Secreted protein that activates macrophage pro-inflammatory responses by binding the host IkappaB-alpha PEST domain. RefSeq leaves it 'hypothetical'. Highly conserved secretory Rv1804c directly interacts with the PEST domain of IkappaB-alpha, activating it in an IKKalpha-independent manner; it inhibits mycobacterial survival and is enriched in attenuated rather than virulent strains (Zheng 2024). Also an antibody-eliciting antigen in active TB (Ben Amor 2005).
